                                             ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all PD No. 1449 District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.5-N in the
area bounded by

        West North Avenue; North Harlem Avenue; West Wabansia Avenue; and North Neva Avenue



to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
